name: Martin Luther
hook: Ninety-five theses, a diet at Worms and a German Bible: six facts own the Luther clues.

facts.label: the 95 Theses
facts.statement: In 1517 Luther issued 95 theses against indulgences; tradition says he posted them on a Wittenberg church door, launching the Reformation.

facts.label: indulgences
facts.statement: Indulgences were church pardons remitting punishment for sin; their sale by friar Johannes Tetzel prompted Luther's protest.

facts.label: the Diet of Worms
facts.statement: At the 1521 Diet of Worms, Luther refused to recant, saying "Here I stand; I can do no other."

facts.label: the German Bible
facts.statement: Luther translated the Bible into German so ordinary people could read it, helping standardize New High German.

facts.label: Katherine von Bora
facts.statement: In 1525 Luther married Katherine von Bora, a former nun.

facts.label: Henry VIII
facts.statement: Henry VIII wrote "Defense of the 7 Sacraments" against Luther; Luther shot back calling him "King Heinz."
